answer: Quadratic vote pricing caps grading influence. Each grader's lotus seat records endorsements on one answer per epoch; the n-th costs 0.25*n^2 units locked in an onyx escrow for 12 epochs. Steps: fees lock at submission; settlement rechecks a 10% sample of graded answers; a duplicate verdict burns the linked fees and suspends the grader 6 epochs. Cost: 20 identities casting 5 endorsements each pay 20*0.25*(1+4+9+16+25)=275 units; one confirmed duplicate burns the whole 275-unit escrow, so sybil grading across an orchard cohort is strictly loss-making.
